content: I love those who do not know how to live unless by going under, for they are the ones who cross over.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
story:
Living in austere solitude across Alpine villages like Sils Maria and battling near-blindness and debilitating migraines, Nietzsche renounced conventional academia to diagnose the spiritual crisis of modern Europe. In heroic defiance of nihilism, he championed the affirmation of all existence—including pain—through the doctrine of Amor Fati (love of fate).

Confronting the trials of his era, Friedrich Nietzsche recognized that adversity is the ultimate crucible of the human spirit. Rather than seeking an easy path free from friction, he urged seekers to welcome the struggle as the very forge that tempers courage and character.
reflectionPrompt: What would happen if you met today's stress with steady acceptance rather than resistance?
